verdict.rationale: Algolia's data-ingestion docs say "Algolia keeps the schedule, the retries, and the transformations" and that these are configured in the dashboard without deploying code, so recurring data-sync jobs can be scheduled. Rules can also be made temporary, a limited form of time-bound automation. Scheduling appears confined to ingestion pipelines, not general-purpose jobs or workflows. Missing for 10: general recurring job/workflow scheduling beyond data ingestion, documented schedule configuration details (cron/intervals), API/CLI/agent-driven schedule management, independent corroboration.
